title: Find the plane in a z-stack
description: Finds which plane of a z-stack the recording's field of view is, as dev's zStackPlaneFinder: the recording's mean image is compared with each plane at the shift the phase correlation finds, by the Pearson correlation of the pixels both cover. Gives the best plane (from 1), its shift and every plane's correlation.

zstack.title: Z-stack
zstack.description: Variable that holds the z-stack: height x width x planes, the planes in place of frames.

firstFrame.title: First frame
firstFrame.description: The first frame to process, from 1 (dev's frame interval): the method works on frames firstFrame..lastFrame only, and its outputs have that many frames.

lastFrame.title: Last frame
lastFrame.description: The last frame to process; 0 for the last frame of the stack.

plane.title: Plane
plane.description: Of a recording with planes, the one to compare.
